item.tib: bsnyan brgyud thegs pa chen po dri med dkar po sum sbyor chog khrigs
item.coloph: de ltar bsnyan (snyan) rgyud rig pa gcer mthong gis (gi) sngon 'gro dkar po sum sbyor gyis (gyi) chog khrigs 'di/ rnal 'byor dbang phyugs (phyug) chen po khyung po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o/ dge ba (bas) 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa thobs (thob) shog/
